prompt: `src/trailhead/elevation.py` has no tests. Write `tests/test_elevation.py` with pytest tests that check its behaviour as documented in the README and the docstrings. Don't change anything under `src/`.
bash_commands: git ls-files && cat README.md src/trailhead/elevation.py && cat pyproject.toml 2>/dev/null; ls tests 2>/dev/null

cat src/trailhead/track.py src/trailhead/geo.py tests/conftest.py tests/test_geo.py; head -40 tests/test_track.py; grep -rn "elevation\|steepest\|gain_and_loss" src tests --include=*.py | grep -v "^src/trailhead/elevation.py"; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5
